meta.name: config-packager
meta.description: Audit, sanitize, and package ~/.claude/ configuration into a distributable repository with versioned releases. Use when updating the public agentic-config repo, syncing local changes, creating releases, or auditing for PII. Handles cross-platform install scripts and semantic versioning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打包你的 Claude 配置成可分享仓库,同时清理敏感信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Claude 的个性化配置安全地开源或备份
copy.tagline_en: Package your Claude config for sharing, with PII sanitized
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Claude config and want to share or back it up safely

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会获得审计、清理和打包 ~/.claude/ 配置的能力，将其整理为可分发的版本化仓库，并自动拦截密钥、个人路径等敏感信息。
howto.when: 当你要求审计并打包配置、同步本地更改或创建版本发布时触发。

say.text: 把 ~/.claude/ 配置审计一遍，检查有没有密钥或个人信息。
say.note: 运行审计脚本，列出文件分类。

say.text: 帮我打包配置并生成到 agentic-config 仓库，顺便打个新版本号。
say.note: 执行打包和版本发布流程。

say.text: 对比一下当前配置和上次打包有什么不同。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to audit, sanitize, and package the ~/.claude/ configuration into a distributable repo with versioned releases, preventing secrets and personal paths from being shipped.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to audit and package the config, sync local changes, or create a versioned release.

say_en.text: Audit my ~/.claude/ config for secrets and personal info.
say_en.note: Runs audit and lists file classification.

say_en.text: Package my config to the agentic-config repo and bump the version.
Diff current config against the last packaged version.
